name: audit_code
description: Performs a defensive static code analysis (SAST) on the workspace to detect OWASP/CWE security vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets/tokens, command injection, RCE, SQL injection, insecure TLS, weak crypto, and dangerous coding patterns.

targetPath.description: Relative path to a file or directory within the workspace to scan (defaults to '.' for entire workspace).

severityThreshold.description: Minimum severity level of findings to report (HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW; defaults to LOW).

fileExtensions.description: Optional list of file extensions to include in scan (e.g. ['.ts', '.js', '.py', '.env']).

maxIssues.description: Maximum number of security findings to return (defaults to 50).
